description: Eight sections, each with its own scale and offset knob and CV, where an unpatched output passes its section down to be mixed into the next output that is patched

params.text: Links the eight scale knobs to the A scale knob, covering B through H with an opaque square while they follow it
Scales that section's signal, -1x fully counter-clockwise through 0x in the centre to +1x fully clockwise, and further under the menu's scale range
Attenuates and inverts that section's scale CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Links the eight offset knobs to the A offset knob, covering B through H with an opaque square while they follow it
Offsets that section's signal, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and with nothing patched in this knob alone sets the output voltage
Attenuates and inverts that section's offset CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%

inputs.text: The signal for that section; an empty jack reads the input of the section to its left and clears any mix building up
Moves that section's scaling; 5V here covers half the knob's travel at full trim, and the total is held inside the chosen scale range
Adds its own voltage to that section's offset at full trim, a volt of input giving a volt more offset

outputs.text: Carries that section scaled and offset, or the average of it and every section to its left whose output was left unpatched; a green light beside it shows when more than one is in it

notes: the sections run A to H, and each unpatched output hands its section on to be averaged into the next patched output, so the H output alone gives a mix of all eight
this module reads only channel 1 of a polyphonic input and its outputs are always one channel
menu: Set offset — sets one section's offset knob to a whole number of semitones between -11 and +11, with a submenu per section
Scale-range mode: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x — widens what the scale knobs cover, 1x meaning -100% to +100%; a light beside the Scale label is dark at 1x, green at 2x, yellow at 5x and red at 10x
Scale-mode: Exp, Linear, Log — bends the response of the scale knobs; the small light beside the Scale label is dark for Linear, green for Exp and red for Log
Order: Scale->Offset, Offset->Scale — chooses whether the input is scaled and then offset, or offset and then scaled; the blue light beside the Offset label is lit for the second
Mix-mode (mix unplugged outputs) — turned off, each output carries only its own section, so an unpatched output no longer feeds its signal down to the next one
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
